title: Enquiry submitted
description: Check whether your EXOBASIS enquiry was sent, see what happens next and return to the contact page if you need to.
intro: The message below shows whether a submission has been confirmed for this visit.

sections.title: Has your message been sent?
sections.body:
We cannot confirm a submission for this visit. Opening this page directly or checking the form in its local preview does not send a message.

If you just used the form, check the result shown there before sending again. Email or encrypted-contact messages are confirmed through their own contact route.

sections.title: After a confirmed submission
sections.body:
Once your enquiry has been sent, we use the reply address you provided to clarify the task and the next step. You may want a specific job carried out, an initial assessment or a free orientation call. We agree the scope and costs of any work with you before you commission it.

The sending confirmation means the message has been accepted for delivery. Appointments, assignments and payments each require their own confirmation.

For an existing assignment, continue through your agreed contact. Keep identity documents, financial records and other sensitive information for the protected exchange arranged for your work.

sections.title: What would you like to explore next?
sections.body: See how EXOBASIS takes an assignment from agreement to practical handover, or find the specific work you need in our services.
